description: This file contains permission and access control helper functions, permission classes, and view mixins for a Django-based application, specifically related to user groups, object ownership, sharing links, and space limits in a recipe management context.

classes.name: GroupRequiredMixin
classes.description: A Django view mixin that enforces group-based permission requirements.

classes.name: OwnerRequiredMixin
classes.description: A Django view mixin that enforces object ownership permissions.

classes.name: CustomIsOwner
classes.description: DRF permission class that checks if the user owns the object.

classes.name: CustomIsOwnerReadOnly
classes.description: DRF permission class that allows safe methods if the user owns the object.

classes.name: CustomIsSpaceOwner
classes.description: DRF permission class that checks if the user owns the space of the object.

classes.name: CustomIsShared
classes.description: DRF permission class that checks if the user is shared for the object.

classes.name: CustomIsGuest
classes.description: DRF permission class that checks if the user belongs to the guest group.

classes.name: CustomIsUser
classes.description: DRF permission class that checks if the user belongs to the user group.

classes.name: CustomIsAdmin
classes.description: DRF permission class that checks if the user belongs to the admin group.

classes.name: CustomIsShare
classes.description: DRF permission class that verifies a valid share link.

classes.name: CustomRecipePermission
classes.description: DRF permission class for recipe API access control.

classes.name: CustomAiProviderPermission
classes.description: DRF permission class for AI provider API access control.

classes.name: CustomUserPermission
classes.description: DRF permission class for user API access control.

classes.name: CustomTokenHasScope
classes.description: Custom OAuth token scope permission class.

classes.name: CustomTokenHasReadWriteScope
classes.description: Custom OAuth token read/write scope permission class.

classes.name: IsReadOnlyDRF
classes.description: DRF permission class for read-only access.

classes.name: IsCreateDRF
classes.description: DRF permission class for create-only access.

methods.name: get_allowed_groups
methods.description: Builds a list of groups including higher-level groups based on input.

methods.name: has_group_permission
methods.description: Checks if a user belongs to allowed groups, with caching.

methods.name: is_object_owner
methods.description: Checks if a user owns a given object.

methods.name: is_space_owner
methods.description: Checks if a user owns the space of a given object.

methods.name: is_object_shared
methods.description: Checks if a user is shared for a given object.

methods.name: share_link_valid
methods.description: Verifies if a share link UUID is valid for a recipe.

methods.name: group_required
methods.description: Decorator enforcing group membership for views.

methods.name: create_space_for_user
methods.description: Creates a new space for a user with default settings.

methods.name: above_space_limit
methods.description: Checks if a space exceeds any limit (recipes, users).

methods.name: above_space_recipe_limit
methods.description: Checks if a space exceeds its recipe limit.

methods.name: above_space_user_limit
methods.description: Checks if a space exceeds its user limit.

methods.name: switch_user_active_space
methods.description: Activates a specific space for a user, deactivating others.
